共同操作

A1

加料顺序：diazo solution -> allenyne/catalyst solution；步骤 1：inject diazo solution into allenyne/catalyst solution via syringe pump；步骤 2：continue reaction

A2

加料顺序：diazo solution -> allenyne/catalyst solution；通法出处：doc_2878b0a078d500b2:GP_B_generic；操作记录：GP-B small-scale procedure；步骤 1：a solution of aryl diazoacetate in CH2Cl2 was injected into the allenyne/Cu(PPh3)3Br solution via a syringe pump over 2 h；步骤 2：the resulting solution was continued at room temperature for 12 h；步骤 3：the mixture was concentrated under reduced pressure；步骤 4：flash column chromatography on silica gel (hexanes/EtOAc = 7:1)

A3

通法出处：doc_2878b0a078d500b2:GP_A_generic；步骤 1：add bromide in one portion and stir until TLC completion；步骤 2：cool to room temperature; filter through Celite, wash with acetone, concentrate；步骤 3：dissolve crude in THF, cool, add tBuOK in portions；步骤 4：warm to room temperature and stir until TLC completion；步骤 5：filter through Celite, wash with CH2Cl2, concentrate；步骤 6：flash column chromatography on silica gel (hexanes/EtOAc)

A4

加料顺序：diazo solution -> allenyne/catalyst solution；通法出处：doc_2878b0a078d500b2:GP_B_generic；操作记录：GP-B small-scale procedure；步骤 1：a solution of aryl diazoacetate in CH2Cl2 was injected into the allenyne/Cu(PPh3)3Br solution via a syringe pump over 2 h；步骤 2：the resulting solution was continued at room temperature for 12 h；步骤 3：the mixture was concentrated under reduced pressure；步骤 4：flash column chromatography on silica gel (hexanes/EtOAc = 15:1 to 7:1)
